_note: Course finder data (Courses page quiz and filters). Built into courses.html by content/gen/course_finder.py. To add a course: add it under 'courses' (key = its content/courses JSON file name without .json), then add its key to one or more 'paths'.

ai-starter.name: AI Starter
ai-starter.blurb: Learn what AI can and can't do, use it safely every day, then see how it fits your business.

ai-leader.name: AI Strategy for Leaders
ai-leader.blurb: Understand LLMs well enough to lead, decide where AI pays off, and plan the roadmap.

ai-builder.name: AI Builder
ai-builder.blurb: Go from how LLMs work to designing, safeguarding and piloting agents and a company-wide AI layer.

automation.name: Digital Automation
automation.blurb: Find the admin and workflow work worth automating, prove the business case, and plan it.

engineering.name: Process Engineering
engineering.blurb: Learn how process plants are defined before they are built, then how to run and improve them once they operate.

security.name: Cyber Safe Business
security.blurb: Protect the business from ransomware, phishing and payment fraud, then use AI and automation safely.

supply.name: Inventory and Supply
supply.blurb: Hold the right stock at the right time, then remove the process problems that cause shortages and excess.

operations.name: Operations Improver
operations.blurb: Organize the workplace, cut waste and lift performance, then run the improvement as a project.

project.name: Improvement Project Leader
project.blurb: Lead an improvement project from assessment to sustained results, with the tools to run it well.

owner.name: Owner Essentials
owner.blurb: Know your numbers, protect cash, set a clear plan and build a dependable sales pipeline.
